summary: Public preview verified: 16/16 static HTTP/markup pytest checks passed; TR/EN desktop/mobile sticky scroll-over, reverse scrolling, continuous video and reduced-motion natural flow passed. Bahar and every East/West plan load correctly. Found three unresolved homepage navigation/visibility regressions.

ui_bugs.issue: TR/EN header stays transparent after white scroll-over content covers the video. At scrollY1100: contentTop=-280.4, heroBottom=819.6, header background rgba(0,0,0,0), menu strokes rgb(255,255,255). White menu/actions disappear against white content.
Click is a no-op: scrollY remains 0. Handler targets nonexistent #liveAllIn; current section is #buildBeyondLiving.

First mobile CTA click stops approximately 1375px above #register, even after 5.5 seconds. TR desktop header CTA also stops approximately 1054px early. A second click succeeds after content has hydrated.

action_items: Update homepage header transparency detection to use the covering content's geometry, not the sticky hero bottom; preserve non-home behavior.
Reserve homepage news-grid space or hydrate it before calculating a long smooth-scroll destination, then ensure first-click register navigation reaches the form.
Retest those three regressions and verify actual iOS Safari and production/cPanel deployment separately.
critical_code_review_comments: script.js:308 evaluates hero.getBoundingClientRect().bottom > 100; sticky geometry keeps this true while opaque white content is under the navbar.
script.js:407 still targets #liveAllIn although both homepages now expose #buildBeyondLiving.

news.js:341-347 hydrates a short placeholder only when it enters the viewport. CTA scrollIntoView uses the pre-hydration target position; grid growth shifts #register by 1375px mobile / 1054px desktop.
East West scripts are ordered synchronously and plan URLs resolve correctly; no console/page errors or media HTTP failures observed during core runs.

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 static-serving checks; unrelated APIs not tested)
success_rate.frontend: Core motion/media checks passed; three navigation/visibility regressions remain

TR/EN hero remains top 0 while content rises; reverse restores origin; video time progresses, reduced motion relative/paused, no horizontal overflow.
